scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Sealed in the underground
of the Prontera Castle...
I didn't expect it to be this huge...
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
被封印在普隆德拉王宮的地下...
沒想到這裡竟然這麼大...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What on earth is there inside?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
裡面到底有什麼東西？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I don't know. Let's investigate the inside, first.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
不知道。先進去調查一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
This...this must be...
Ymir's Heart!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
這...這一定是...尤彌爾之心！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
This...
This is Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
這...這是尤彌爾之心...

scripts.text: ~Rumbling~
scripts.translation: ~轟隆隆~

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Why is this place shaking?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
為什麼這裡在震動？！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Grunts~ They must've started attacking this place, too.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
唔...他們連這裡也開始進攻了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Grins~ Delighted to see you all.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~咧嘴一笑~很高興見到各位。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
!!
You've got to be kidding me!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
！！
開什麼玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
From this moment on, we the Immortal Legion by Lord Valkyrie Himelmez
will take over here.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
從現在起，這裡由瓦爾基里希梅爾梅茲大人麾下的不朽軍團接管。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What? How dare you!
I'm game. Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
什麼？竟敢如此！
我奉陪到底。來吧！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Grins~ Do I look like I have the time to deal with a petty thing like you, human?
But, out of pure mercy, I'll let you taste the fearful power of the Immortal Legion just a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
~咧嘴一笑~人類，你以為我有空理會你這種小角色？
不過，我就大發慈悲，讓你嚐嚐不朽軍團的恐怖力量。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Grunts~ When did all the legionnaires get here?
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
唔...什麼時候來了這麼多軍團士兵？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Chuckles~ I think you're not that bad for a human.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呵呵...以人類來說，還算有兩下子。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
But do you think you can get away from this, again? Wake up, my underlings!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
但你覺得你還能再次逃脫嗎？醒來吧，我的部下們！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What...what's up with this monster?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
這...這怪物是怎麼回事？！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Ah...
I'll let you in on me before I go.
I'm Bijou.
I'm the adjutant to Lord Valkyrie Himelmez.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
啊...離開之前，讓你知道我是誰吧。
我叫碧珠，是瓦爾基里希梅爾梅茲大人的副官。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Groans~
No Valkyrie's subordinates ever disappointed me and neither did you.
Ymir's Heart is a huge energy source. For what do you want to use it anyway?
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
呃...瓦爾基里的部下還真是一個樣，你也不例外。
尤彌爾之心蘊含著巨大的能量，你們到底想拿它做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
......
You don't need to know. You're going to be wiped out soon anyway.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
...
沒必要告訴你，反正你馬上就要消失了。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I don't think you'd use it for any good cause.
I'll stop Bijou from taking Ymir's Heart. You go ahead and take care of that huge monster!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
反正不會用來做好事。
我來阻止碧珠奪取尤彌爾之心，你去對付那個大傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Was that it...? Has it gone now?
So what's left now is...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
結束了嗎...？它走了嗎？
那麼現在剩下的是...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Me...I'm the only one left...
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我...我是唯一剩下的了...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
What?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
什麼？！

scripts.text: ~POW!~

[Iris]
Aaarrghhh---!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
啊啊啊——！！！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I must say it was rather unexpected. ~Chuckles~
I didn't expect anyone to defeat Amdarais that I spent three good years to complete.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
真是出乎意料，呵呵。
我花了整整三年才完成的暗答萊屍，居然會被人打倒。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You will pay
for ruining my three-year efforts!!
Slowly...
And horribly painfully...!!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我要讓你為毀掉我三年的心血付出代價！！
慢慢地...
讓你痛苦萬分...！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Groans~ I can't believe nothing seems to work!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
呃...怎麼會，竟然什麼辦法都不管用！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Chuckles~
I'll let you taste what despair feels like.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呵呵...讓你嚐嚐什麼叫絕望。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Frost Diver!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
冰凍術！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Groans~
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
呃...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
How does it feel? Painful, eh?
You must become paralyzed by now.
...But don't expect me to kill you that easily...
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
感覺如何？很痛吧？
你現在應該已經癱瘓了。
...但別指望我會輕易殺了你...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I should take care of this downright annoying cleric gal first.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我應該先解決這個煩人的牧師女孩。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I...Iris!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
艾...艾莉絲！！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Sarah...?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
莎拉...？

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
So this is it...
This is the underground of Prontera Castle.
The place where the first Ymir's Heart is sealed.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
原來這裡就是普隆德拉王宮的地下...第一顆尤彌爾之心的封印之地。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
And that must be...
Ymir's Heart...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
那麼，那就是...尤彌爾之心...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
What brought you all the way up here?
Sarah Irine.
I didn't expect you would show up here.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你怎麼跑到這裡來了，莎拉·艾琳？
真沒想到會在這裡見到你。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
What do you think you're doing here, Bijou?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
碧珠，你在這裡幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Yes, I was in the middle of taking care of the annoying bugs.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
是的，我正準備處理那些煩人的蟲子。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
What kind of answer is that, Bijou?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
碧珠，這是什麼回答？

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
My question was: what are you still doing here, totally goofing off, and, why didn't you break any sealing off of Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
我問的是，你為什麼還在這裡磨蹭？尤彌爾之心的封印怎麼還沒解除？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Well, that's uh...I did break the 1st seal, though.
This place will be cleaned up in no time. There is nothing for you to worry about, Sarah.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
嗯，那個...我已經解除了第一道封印。
這裡很快就會清理乾淨。莎拉，你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Trust me and consider it done. Please be yourself as proud Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
相信我，事情已經辦妥了。請保持你作為瓦爾基里的驕傲。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(~Scoffs~ What an uptight, pathetic Valkyrie she is! I can't believe a greenhorn like you are treated the same as Himelmez. That is so unfair.)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（哼，真是個死板又可悲的瓦爾基里！像你這種乳臭未乾的新手，居然和希梅爾梅茲平起平坐，太不公平了。）

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
You must be out of your mind, Bijou...There is no Himelmez here.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
碧珠，你一定是瘋了...這裡根本沒有希梅爾梅茲。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
....~Gasps~
I'm out of breath!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
...哈啊！喘...喘不過氣了！

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
You'd better keep your mouth shut!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
你最好閉嘴！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Coughs~
~Keeps coughing~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
咳！
咳咳咳...

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
I can certainly do without a subordinate who wastes time for this kind of petty job.
Let me take that Ymir's Heart...myself.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
我可不需要連這點小事都要磨蹭半天的部下。
尤彌爾之心...就由我親自來取。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(She is Valkyrie, indeed. Oh, what can you do about that?)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（她確實是瓦爾基里。唉，你能怎麼辦呢？）

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
The time is right!
Frost Diver!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
時機到了！
冰凍術！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
What did you say?!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你說什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Whoa...That was a close; call.
How could this happen?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哇...好險。
怎麼會發生這種事？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
This magic...
This must be high-level magic as I expected. It's pretty tough to cast it.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
這魔法...果然是高階魔法，施放起來真費勁。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(What is this?! Did she just master the magic that I used on her?)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（怎麼回事？！我才剛對她用過這魔法，她就已經學會了？）

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Iris! This is a healing potion.
Drink it and you'll come to your senses.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
艾莉絲！這是一瓶治療藥水。
喝下去，你就會恢復神智。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
~Muffled sound~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
唔唔...

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Oh, you woke up now?
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
哦，你醒了？

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Umm....
~Vomiting sound~
Yuck! Is this bitter!
What the heck is this?!
What did you give to me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
唔...嘔！
呸，好苦！這什麼鬼東西？！你給我喝了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
So you woke up, Iris.
I'm so relieved.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
艾莉絲，你終於醒了。
我鬆了一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
~Sighs~ By the way, Fenrir!
What about Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
唉，對了，芬里爾！尤彌爾之心怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
(...Fenrir? I thought too much about Ymir's Heart and totally forgot about her. If my guess is right, she must be...!)
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
（...芬里爾？我因為太在意“尤彌爾之心”而完全忘了她。如果我的猜測沒錯，她應該是...！）

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Exhales~ I see. That's right.
That beast's blood flowing through your body...That was the answer!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呼...原來如此。
你體內流著的那股獸血...答案就在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Then, let me serve you the right way! ~Chuckles~
I didn't expect to see the hero from a thousand years ago!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
那可得好好招待你了，呵呵。
真沒想到，竟能見到千年前的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Die!!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
去死吧！！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
...Be careful. She's about to attack!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
...小心。她要攻擊了！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
~Grunts~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
呃...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Evil laughter~ Die!
Clerics deserve to die!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
嘿嘿嘿，去死吧！
牧師都該死！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Iris!!
No! Stop!!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
艾莉絲！！
不！住手！！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Chuckles~
So you're looking for a partner, eh?
Good idea, but...I think it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呵呵...想找同伴幫忙？主意不錯，可惜...已經晚了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Because...
This will be the final, fatal blow to you. Wahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
因為...
這將是對你的最後一擊，也是致命一擊。哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
....~Sighs~
Huh?...In my stomach...
This knife...
Sa...Sarah...? How?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
...哈...咦？肚子裡...這把刀...
莎...莎拉...？怎麼會？

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Is that all you want to say?
Don't worry. I'll let Himelmez know of your brave contribution. Don't blame me, Bijou.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
遺言就這些？放心，我會把你的英勇表現轉告希梅爾梅茲。
別怪我，碧珠。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Why...? Tell me why!
...That...that little chick...Was that it? Because she's your sister? Was that it? Tell me, Sarah!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
為什麼...？告訴我為什麼！
...那個...那個小丫頭...是因為她是你的妹妹嗎？是因為這個嗎？告訴我，莎拉！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
~Groans~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呃啊...

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
......
Your soul has been set free, Bijou.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
...
你的靈魂自由了，碧珠。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
(Did she save me...?)
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
（是她救了我...嗎？）

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Sarah...
It's Sarah, right?
People say we parted when we were little...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
莎拉...
是你嗎，莎拉？
聽說我們小時候就分開了...

scripts.text:
[Iris]
...So what's your plan, huh? Why...why did you save me?!
Don't you ever think this will ever change my belief! I will never, ever forgive you!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
...你到底想幹什麼？為什麼...為什麼救我？！
別以為這樣就能讓我改主意，我永遠、永遠不會原諒你！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Mom...Dad...Every people in our town. I'm going to revenge!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
媽媽...爸爸...還有鎮上所有人，我一定要為他們報仇！

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Shut that mouth!
Don't be a drama queen as if you're the only victim here.
They just paid the price for what they sinned. The sin that they committed by killing my mother 12 years ago.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
閉嘴！少擺出一副只有你受害的樣子。
他們不過是在償還自己的罪，十二年前殺害我母親的罪！

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Do you want me to tell you the truth? Those 'loved ones' you're incessantly talking about...Our great elder and the people in our town were actually...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
你想聽真話嗎？那些你口中不停唸叨的“親人”...我們偉大的長老和城鎮裡的人，其實是...

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
......
Stop it...
Ymir's Heart comes first, no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
...
夠了...不管怎樣，先拿到尤彌爾之心。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Mark my word.
I didn't let you live.
I will let you die soon.
I make sure you no longer see the light of day the next time when we meet.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
記住，我可沒有饒你一命。
你的死期很快就到，下次見面，我絕不會再讓你見到明天的太陽。

scripts.text:
[Sarah]
Don't you ever let anyone kill you until then, Iris.
I'd better bid farewell for today, then.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉]
在那之前，艾莉絲，千萬別讓別人殺了你。
那麼，今天就到此為止吧。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
~Grunts~ That Valkyrie destroyed the ceiling when taking Ymir's Heart!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
唔...那個瓦爾基里奪取尤彌爾之心時，把天花板都毀了！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
We'd better get out of here, too! This place is too dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
我們也得趕緊離開這裡！這地方太危險了！
